page.overview:
What is Another Hard Day's Night?

Another Hard Day's Night is a song from the 1965 US Soundtrack version of the album Help!. It was written and composed by George Martin. It's an instrumental, Indian-oriented version of the song A Hard Day's Night. In 2014, it was released on the The US Albums box set.
